newsitem.title: LATVIA: VELDZE SAYS '96 LOSS AT 197,044 LATS.
newsitem.headline: VELDZE SAYS '96 LOSS AT 197,044 LATS.

text.p: Veldze soft drink maker said on Monday that it had a 1996 loss of 197,044 lats on net turnover of 296,462 lats.
Veldze registered a 1995 loss of 2,494 lats on net turnover of 278,270 lats.
"Veldze made an actual operating loss of 65,300 lats and wrote off bad debts worth 63,502 lats and non-material assets of 38,184 lats," Larisa Ivanova, Veldze's chief accountant, told Reuters.
"We also created a reserve for bad debts worth 30,000 lats," she said.
She added that the company's loss for the first three months of the year was 1,458 lats on turnover of 76,398 lats.
